name: tokeneater
description: Play tokeneater, the multiplayer cell-eating game, in a Claude Code pane (terminal or desktop app) while a prompt runs.

nickname.title: Nickname
nickname.description: The name other players see above your cell (up to 16 characters). Empty: the server picks one.

autoOpen.title: Open on prompt
autoOpen.description: Open the game's pane by itself when you send a prompt (in the desktop app, or a fullscreen terminal at least 144 columns wide). Off: only /tokeneater opens it.
